Module 2 · 12 min

Built-in validation

Why this matters: the browser can reject bad input before any of your code runs.

Add constraints as attributes, and the browser checks them when the form is submitted:

<input id="email" type="email" required>

Frameworks build on the same attributes — an Angular template binds the field with {{ email }} and still relies on required.

Key takeaways
  • required, type and pattern are checked on submit.
  • Invalid fields stop the submission and show a message.
  • Always validate again on the server.
